programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功。

programme.title: E28
programme.desc: 少女陳寶銀為救母親，無奈被卷入命運洪流，從青樓逃落後幾經輾轉成為船娘；在她最落魄時重逢曾救過她的書生溫肅，此時溫肅已家道中落，為救家人忍辱成為長公主的男寵；兩個身處泥潭的底層男女在亂世中相互取暖、彼此救贖，上演了一段充滿破碎感卻又堅韌動人的愛情故事。

programme.desc: In this episode of Spiky Gold Hunters, the crew of the San Nicholas are heading to the southern most part of Stewart Island, the last stop before Antarctica. programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E20
programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: E38
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: Blurr
programme.desc: Gayatri, a woman with a degenerative eye disorder, is slowly losing her eyesight. She, however, has to solve the mystery of her twin sister Gautami's death. Release Year: 2022 Director: Ajay Bahl

programme.title: Hero No. 1
programme.desc: A wealthy business heir plights his troth to household chores for the sake of love. Posing as Raju, the man of many talents, he sweeps, mops, cooks, sings, and dances his way into the hearts of his girlfriend's near and dear ones. Release Year: 1997 Director: David Dhawan

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world’s 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature’s best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summer’s soundtrack or go silent forever.

programme.title: E5 - The Hollow Heart
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: E3 - Super Senses
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon’s internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: E3 - Realm of the Spectacled Bear
programme.desc: Get to know South America’s only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: Pierce
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Zihan was incarcerated for what he maintains was the accidental death of an opponent. Zijie wants some connection (and fencing tips) from his enigmatic older brother, but their mother is convinced of Zihan's malevolence and seeks to end their brotherly bond. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: The chaos began at the Winter Solstice dinner eight years ago. The father lost his temper, the son, not able to forgive his father, ran away from home. Eight years have passed, and the family's relationship is still cold and distant. A cousin returns to Hong Kong from England and hopes to gather everyone for a Winter Solstice dinner. The long-awaited gathering prompted everyone to rethink their relationships with family members. Some choose to leave, some are back. When things are about to fall apart, it might as well be an opportunity to mend connections.

programme.title: E16
programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。

programme.title: E23
programme.desc: 講述柔道選手出身的女主角溫心（金世正飾），因傷被迫放棄當運動員，轉職網絡漫畫編輯，揭開人生新一頁的同時，亦反映韓國網絡漫畫業界激烈競爭的情况。​

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 擁有雙重面貌卻守節十五年的蒙面寡婦，在白天是個足不出戶、行為謹慎的女人。到了晚上，她就會翻牆出去，戴著面紗去照顧那些有需要的人。在某天晚上卻遇到了追查年幼時慘死的父親死因的男人。這使她開始對未來有所憧憬。但當他們一起捲入一場意想不到的事件時，生活發生了巨大的變化。

programme.title: Someone, Someday[Live]
programme.desc: Someone, Someday follows Billy (Kathryn Bernardo), the young CEO of a dating app that empowers women to find their destined true love-while secretly carrying the heartbreak that has kept her from finding her own. Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.
